name: kidney-stone-detection
description: Medical deep learning pipeline for binary classification of Kidney Stones in axial CT images (Mendeley Data V2 benchmark).

context.domain: Medical Computer Vision & Axial CT Image Classification
context.dataset: Mendeley Data V2 (201 patients: 161 development, 40 sealed test)
key_principles: Strict patient-level data partitioning to prevent data leakage across slices
5-fold cross-validation with out-of-fold (OOF) optimal threshold tuning via Youden's J
Deterministic seed enforcement across NumPy, Python random, and TensorFlow

review_instructions: Verify that any changes to data loading or splitting never mix slices from the same patient ID between train, validation, or test sets.
Ensure image preprocessing and augmentation operations maintain correct channel dimensions (1-channel axial CT) and normalized intensity ranges.
Check that CLI subcommands in train.py (smoke, prepare, cv, finalize) conform to the pipeline spec.
Ensure unit tests in tests/ maintain high test coverage.
